join.grain: one scene row per original transaction, no filtering or reordering
join.identity: from_address/to_address always equal original sender/recipient; no anchor/state reinterpretation

account_identity: original lowercase 0x address, never merged by profile/site
account_role_assumption: all logical IoT device accounts; cloud/edge/service identities are not assigned
profile_mapping: SHA256(version,seed,purpose,account), 128-bit prefix, modulo frozen profile count
site_mapping: independent purpose label, modulo frozen site count; does not preassign a shard
template_selection: sender profile + stable hash of global tx index and entire original row; with replacement

units.flowDuration: raw unchanged; publisher labels seconds but numeric-scale conflict is unresolved
units.rate: not generated; do not assume bytes/second

co_location: raw self-link probability retained separately; effective quality=1 by explicit assumption
required_future_adapter_checks: do not reverse real from/to identities
do not pre-place all receivers as fixed anchors
resolve duration units and zero duration treatment
account type shares contain only device in this base scenario
